test_title: PYST 05: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
n a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’,

‘A − B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the father of B’, and

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

How is P related to T if ‘P − Q × R ÷ S + T’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Husband
 Wife
 Father
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: P - Q × R ÷ S + T

Decoding step-by-step:

 
• P - Q: P is the wife of Q
 
• Q × R: Q is the father of R
 
• R ÷ S: R is the sister of S
 
• S + T: S is the husband of T

Combining all these relationships:

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9e4b006158b55edb053404caa67bd3c7dfaf49a075bae04269ee201afd8191b.png] 

Therefore, P is T's husband's mother.

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3: Husband's mother.**
